class.name: CubismDependencyTracker
class.brief_description: Tracks imported model dependencies in the editor.
class.description: Editor-only node owned by [GDCubismPlugin]. It schedules bounded dependency scans, detects changed or restored inputs and requests reimport while preserving the last successful resource on validation failure. It reads engine-owned import metadata but does not rewrite it. Do not add this node to game scenes or create duplicate trackers.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns a diagnostic snapshot with [code]busy[/code] and [code]models[/code]. Each model entry contains [code]resource[/code], [code]source[/code], [code]status[/code] and [code]attempts[/code]. A non-busy tracker is not proof that every entry imported successfully or that export validation passed.

method.name: request_scan
method.description: Requests a scan on a later editor update. The request is coalesced with pending work and waits while filesystem import work is active; this method does not synchronously rebuild a model.
